map.重点：预防光老化，做好基础保湿: Focus: prevent photoaging and keep up basic hydration

map.📚 深度解析：皮肤年龄多维度测试: 📚 In-depth analysis: multi-dimensional skin age test
map.25 岁后想客观了解皮肤真实年龄，对比生理年龄判断早衰风险。: If you are past 25 and want an objective reading of your skin's true age, compare it with your chronological age to spot early aging.
map.医美或抗老护肤前做基线评估，便于后续对比改善效果。: Establish a baseline before medical aesthetics or anti-aging skincare so later improvements are easy to compare.
map.护肤品牌方收集用户多维问卷，给出口红、精华等抗老品类的个性化建议。: Skincare brands collect multi-dimensional questionnaires from users and turn them into personalized suggestions for anti-aging categories such as lipstick and serum.
map.设皱纹 38 分、色斑 42 分、弹性 40 分、毛孔 45 分、敏感 30 分: Set wrinkles at 38, dark spots at 42, elasticity at 40, pores at 45 and sensitivity at 30 (60 points each), with weights of 0.25/0.20/0.20/0.15/0.20. The weighted score = 38×0.25 + 42×0.20 + 40×0.20 + 45×0.15 + 30×0.20 = 39.0 points. The 35-45 band corresponds to a skin age roughly 2-5 years above chronological age, indicating mild premature aging.
map.问卷结果能替代皮肤科医生诊断吗？: Can questionnaire results replace a dermatologist's diagnosis?
map.不能。皮肤年龄测试是基于自评问卷的粗略估算，用于日常参考与趋势跟踪；色斑、弹性等: No. The skin age test is a rough estimate based on a self-report questionnaire, meant for daily reference and trend tracking. Dark spots, elasticity and the like need professional instruments such as VISIA imaging or a dermatoscope; if anything looks abnormal, please see a doctor.
map.各维度权重是怎么定的？: How are the dimension weights determined?
map.权重反映各老化征象对视觉年龄的影响程度，皱纹、色斑权重较高；不同量表分档阈值不同: The weights reflect how much each aging sign influences perceived visual age, so wrinkles and dark spots carry more weight. Different scales use different band thresholds; this tool uses a 100-point mapping and reports a range rather than a precise age in years.
